mintAuthority.summary: stUSD has a wrapper-local arbitrary mint authorization path: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant MINTER_ROLE, whose issueFromWrapper(address,uint256) requires no deposit. The immutable 1B MAX_SUPPLY bounds nominal supply but does not prevent durable unbacked issuance. Circle parent exposure remains inherited separately.

controls.label: StoneYield stUSD wrapper contract (MINTER_ROLE / issueFromWrapper)
controls.capDescription: MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant (≈1B tokens); issueFromWrapper() is gated by MINTER_ROLE and enforces MAX_SUPPLY ceiling.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb4d3c1bb59be7b419af4e10e9b240f425782b22a) returned true; wrapper() on stUSD returned 0xb4d3c1bb…. Contract source (BscScan) confirms issueFromWrapper() requires MINTER_ROLE and checks MAX_SUPPLY; MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant with no setter.

controls.label: StoneYield DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (EIP-7702 EOA)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x9ab82f8e97bf3202173b92e06e6593f336b76ccf) returned true. eth_getCode on that address returned 23-byte EIP-7702 delegation designator (0xef0100 + 20-byte target 0x63c0c19a282a1b52b07dd5a65b58948a07dae32b); it is an EOA with EIP-7702 delegation. grantRole() is controlled by this EOA.

review.evidence: Historical native-control observations are retained without renewal. At BSC block 103632643, wrapper() identified 0xb4d3c1bb59be7b419af4e10e9b240f425782b22a, which held MINTER_ROLE, and 0x9ab82f8e97bf3202173b92e06e6593f336b76ccf held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE with an EIP-7702 delegation designator rather than a Safe runtime. The July 21 review at BSC block 111254044 found zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots for the directly deployed STUSD and wrapper; the separate SUSDC proxy controls the deposit asset. The D14 review at BSC block 125056043, hash 0xd7176228973022a09c22ff423dc34b79ad5ffb371d33f7d06206b7ad3a529e51, established that exact-matched STUSD issueFromWrapper(address,uint256) checks MINTER_ROLE and the fixed one-billion-token MAX_SUPPLY, not a deposit or collateral transfer. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant MINTER_ROLE and create durable unbacked tokens for an arbitrary recipient, so the numerical ceiling is not a collateral-backed economic bound. FD23 re-read the exact-deployment Sourcify source on 2026-10-20: VERSION 2.0.1 and the same AccessControl/issueFromWrapper semantics remain published. The architecture, wrapper and monitoring documents describe treasury reserve sweeps, cumulative deposits and rewards, but publish no dated recurring reconciliation of all STUSD liabilities to current complete strategy assets. The earlier not-applicable reconciliation label was an inference from the wrapper form and finite nominal cap; neither makes reconciliation structurally inapplicable. Reconciliation is corrected to unknown, not none. Known unbounded-adverse mint authority, supervision none, parent Circle exposure, all original pins and the October 3 review start remain unchanged.
